success.title: WP Mail Function Available
success.details: The WordPress mail function is properly configured and available.
steps: Check server mail logs if needed

error.title: WP Mail Function Issues
error.details: The WordPress mail function is not available or properly configured.
steps: Contact your hosting provider for support

learn_more.description: The WordPress mail function (wp_mail) is essential for sending emails from your website, including notifications, password resets, and contact form submissions.
